desc:
🦁 ZOO ESCAPE 🦓

Life in a cage is boring. It’s time to break out! 
Escape the zoo, hit the city, and pull off epic robberies at the Bank, Gas Station, and Jewelry Store. Build up your cash, unlock new animals with special abilities, and cause absolute chaos!

Want to be the good guy? Play as a Zoo Guard! Gear up with tranquilizers, deploy the SWAT minigun, and stop the animal crime wave before it gets out of hand. 🚨

🐾 Play as 24 unique animals, each with their own special powers
💰 Pull off high-stakes city heists & earn big payouts
🚗 Drive getaway vehicles or ride in the SWAT truck
🔑 Steal keycards to access secret areas & weapons
🔓 Break other animals out of jail when they get caught
🚨 Collect bounties on escaping animals as a Guard
🦴 Roleplay with friends across the map

Make sure to join our group for future updates!

Can YOU escape the zoo?
